details.reason: wrote .js but repo package.json has "type":"module"; renamed to .cjs

lesson_hint: Check package.json type before writing new node scripts; prefer .cjs for repo-internal helper scripts to avoid ESM ceremony.

flags: dzen.ru wrongly bucketed under DNS-infra deny

lesson_hint: When writing deny-pattern filters, sanity-check by spot-listing each pattern's intent in a comment block — would have caught dzen.ru miscategorization.

details.flag: cross-PR doc drift — sites.json changed under me in PR #18 final commit; classification map had dead hp.com entry

lesson_hint: When opening a PR that depends on a file just modified in a sibling PR, re-diff against the post-fix state before drafting the new PR's docs.

details.flag: ce-real-reserve selector had dead first alternative (#ce-real-reserve id didn't exist)

lesson_hint: Real-CTA CEs in fixtures should always have a meaningful element id matching the action (Amazon precedent: #add-to-cart-button, #buy-now-button); ground-truth selector then lists both id and data-gt-id.

details.request: add Google Sheet sync step before resuming fixture builds

lesson_hint: Mid-queue scope changes are normal — pause cleanly, log state in LOOP-LOG, defer the queue rather than barrel-rolling through old plan.

details.flag: Section 2 append placement risk — Sheets API append finds end of enclosing table

lesson_hint: When writing into a table that may share a tab with another table, never use Sheets API append() — explicitly compute the target row by scanning the column for the data range you own.
Secret-management ops are deliberately blocked. User must always do these phases themselves; design pipelines so the secret-config step is a clear one-time onboarding doc, not buried in the loop.

details.flag: Forced Action / paywall classification tension with prompt's intrinsic-to-service carve-out

lesson_hint: When a fixture's DP classification is contested in the literature, ship it as a deliberate stress test with a known_stress_test_notes field rather than reclassifying — the model's response is itself useful data.

details.reason: Bash loop hit unrelated 'claude native binary not installed' shell-wrapper interference mid-iteration; recovered by running grep checks individually

lesson_hint: If a long bash loop fails partway through with unfamiliar errors, fall back to running each check as a standalone command rather than retrying the whole loop.

details.flag: single element legitimately satisfies multiple DP harm tests (cancel link = both Confirm shaming via label + buried half of False hierarchy)

lesson_hint: When DPs naturally overlap on a single element, use accepts_types as a multi-type list rather than splitting into 2 entries. Avoids under-crediting in scoring.
